description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order of Recognizing the National School of Business Management Limited as a degree awarding institute
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the recognition of a private institution (National School of Business Management Limited) as a degree-awarding institute under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It constitutes a regulatory action by the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, establishing legal authority for the institution to award specific degrees and postgraduate diplomas. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers, creates regulatory frameworks for education, and rescinds previous legal orders, making it a matter of legal and regulatory administration rather than government personnel or structure changes.
